Before opening this, check [COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md](../../COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md). Most uses are
free and need no license: your own practice, your own organization's internal use including at
a for-profit company, and accredited teaching. Teaching the ideas in your own words is always
free, including for money.

framework as ideas only.)

**Who is the audience, and what is being charged for?**

**Roughly what scale?**
(A one-off workshop and a product with 10,000 seats are different conversations, and small
independent operators should expect that reflected in the terms.)
